transcript.text: You have to do so much volume of
activity that it would be unreasonable
that you would suck. If you were to
write out the equation of like, okay,
how many public speeches would I need to
give for it to be unreasonable that I
would suck? Is it 10? Is it 100? Is it
like, there's no way that I would suck
after this many. And then all of your
effort gets really narrowed to just
doing that. And the key part of this is
not just to do the 1,000, but after
every 10 or every 20, looking at the top
10 or 20% and saying, what did I do well
there? It's not just doing 100 reach
outs. You have to do 100 reach outs and
then do more of what worked.
